subject: Unforeseen field condition: deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall at

messages.text: We found the deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall at Placement Zone 2; see Project Specifications Division 00 for the assumed condition. Our proposal is to shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan -- let us know if that works or if you need to review first. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. This condition will require a change order. No broader schedule impact is expected. Please respond this week so we can keep the crew moving.
